title: 1983 Donruss #571 Tony LaRussa Chicago White Sox
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1983 Donruss #571 Tony LaRussa Chicago White Sox trading card is a must-have for any MLB fan. The card features an iconic photo of the legendary baseball coach and is a part of the 1983 Donruss set. It is a white parallel/variety card and is an unsigned, unautographed sports trading card manufactured by Donruss in 1983. 

The card is perfect for collectors and fans alike, and is a great addition to any sports memorabilia collection. Its features include a base set and its aspects include the player/athlete name, the team name, the card number, the season, and the manufacturer. This card is a piece of baseball history and is a great way to pay tribute to one of the greatest coaches in MLB.
